answer: Since the cipher tally is stored with the tide verdict, the raven audit can re-derive it and a padded answer exposes the same claim repeated. A farm padding one paragraph thus cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, because length is not what is counted. A tier-3 answer must contain at least 9 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. That is 14 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
